notes:
Summary: ArgonWave runs a customer-facing trading assistant and a real-time alerting pipeline. Very latency-sensitive and cost conscious. Key quotes: "Need p95 end-to-end <100ms across NA for chat signals" (CTO), and "cannot send raw customer order data outside region; strict residency" (Head of Security).

Primary constraints and asks:
- Target workload: chat + reranking for live signals; ~200 qps sustained during market-open spikes, burst to 800 qps for 2-3 minutes.
- Latency target: 50-100ms p95 for short prompts (~40-80 tokens), 150ms acceptable for long contexts.
- Cost sensitivity: want to understand token-unit economics; willing to trade model size (quantized) for 3-4x cost reduction if quality holds.
- Perf benchmarking: require end-to-end numbers (p50/p95/p99), tokenization-time breakdown, KV cache hit rates, and cost per 1k tokens for each model variant. Bench across NA/EU region pairs and with network emulation.
- Optimize interest: dynamic batching windows, prefix/KV caching strategy, 4-bit quantization profiles, and kernel selection guidance for their model family. Also want advice on autoscaling policy for Dedicated.

Security/compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML), KMS for key management, audit logs for all inference calls, and a DPA with data residency clauses. On-prem option is required for regulated accounts.

POC plan (agreed verbally on 2026-02-18):
1) 2-week perf bench (redwood-run) comparing float/4-bit/8-bit with caching on/off; capture token cost and latency distribution.
2) 4-week staged POC on Dedicated with VPC peering and canary rollout.
3) Security review: ship security FAQ + infra diagram to their InfoSec (drives above).

Customer signals and temperament: pragmatic, engineering-first. CTO willing to adopt quantized flows if regressions are measurable. Head of Sec is conservative on residency — needs Private or on-prem for production. Procurement timeline tied to legal signoff (forecast 2026-04).
